Name: The Sushi Project
Author: BeazNees
Description:
[center][size=3][img]https://proxy.duckduckgo.com/iu/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fi.imgur.com%2FV0HzhNi.png[/img][/size][/center]
﻿﻿
[size=3]This mods adds 34 Sushi recipes to the game. 

Using Rice, Seaweed and a multitude of fish (as well as other mischievous ingredients) you too can live your sushi dreams!
All recipes use vanilla ingredients!

The recipes as well as a few random assortment of sushi is available trough the vendor. 
The vendor comes to town on [b]Tuesdays & Saturdays, 6am to 8pm, on the arrowhead island in the forest[/b], above the Hat Mouse.*[/size]

[size=3]* Some mods change the layout of the forest, so the location might be a little different with mods that edit the forest[/size]

[size=3][i]Check the images tab for screenshots on where the stall is in vanilla and with SVE[/i][/size]

[center][size=3][img]https://i.ibb.co/ksB52J0x/disclaimer.png[/img][/size][/center]
[size=3]Please note that some creative liberties were taken, as some of the dishes include fish which simply don't exist in Stardew Valley. Feel free to suggest a better alternative in the comments though, I love feedback.

Some of the item descriptions contain puns and jokes, and for that I am not sorry.

Some of the sushi items are tagged as [i]haram and/or tref[/i] based on the fish used, I tried to use the most common schools of thought for both. 
I used [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_halal_and_kosher_fish]this wikipedia list[/url], [url=https://www.ka.org.au/consumer-resources/common-kosher-and-non-kosher-fish]this blog post[/url] and [url=https://wehalal.co/blog/can-fish-be-halal/]this article [/url]to determine which fish are tagged as such. [/size]

[size=3][url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Vrbras3FTTdalsqcCNvh7gitqnaunLWLhtHgpEiL_4o/edit?usp=sharing]Stardew Fish Halal & Kosher Spreadsheet[/url] (made by me)[/size]

[center][size=3][img]https://i.ibb.co/nM215nt3/features.png[/img][/size][/center]
[size=3]
34 types of sushi recipes, available to make in the kitchen. 
Support for custom NPC gift tastes supports For [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16326]The Fishmonger[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10950]Jorts and Jean the Helper Cats[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5295]Mister Ginger[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url] (only for Lady Sheba atm, feel free to suggest others) & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6398]Juliet and Jessie the Joja Clerks[/url] (only for Jessie)﻿﻿﻿﻿

The gift tastes are as follows:
﻿[/size]
[spoiler][size=3][b]General:[/b]
MOST of the sushi items are listed as normal cooking items; universally liked (except for Krobus, who dislikes them)
Niji is a universal love (except for Haley, who hates it)

[b]Special NPC gift tastes:[/b]
[i]Evelyn [/i]hates any sushi with fish in it, as her vanilla gift tastes indicates she hates fish.
[i]Jessie [/i]hates any sushi with animal products, as she is vegan. 
[i]Willy[/i] ,[i]Constance, Jorts, Jean, Mister Ginger and Lady Sheba [/i]love any sushi item with fish in it [/size][/spoiler]
[size=3]
If you're the mod author for custom NPC/s and want special gift tastes for my sushi, please let me know, I love hearing from people.[/size]

[b][i]Where is the stall?[/i][/b]

Arrow head island in the forest, few steps above the hat mouse (see mod images) on Tuesdays & Saturdays. The coordinators themselves won't change but it might look different if you use any mods that edits the forest map.[/size]
